detail:
- **Documented**: 37 of 107 modules carry an author's summary

18 requirements: 11 checked and 7 refuted.
label: organisms
quotes: BarSeries
BarSeries is a chart organism component that renders a bar series with animated reveal and formatted numeric labels.
Bars
Bars is a horizontal bar chart: each row its label, a bar that grows from the left when it comes into view (or its Step lights up) and its figure at the tip.
Blobs
Blobs are the two soft yellow stains that drift behind the whole talk.
BlockTitle
BlockTitle is a numbered block title and, right behind it, its photo.
CardList
CardList is the stack of full-width bands (Card in its row variant).
Closing
Closing is the last slide before the footer: the closing sentence in statement, with an optional body at half the grid and a final line.
Cover
Cover is the first stop of a talk: the title in statement, one line per line, the question, the lead, the event card, the client logo and the full-bleed photo glued to the bottom.
Cycle
Cycle is a ring of phases with an arc of progress.
Deck
The Deck module implements the Deck organism component that assembles and navigates between slides in a presentation, wiring up theme toggling and stop/mark navigation via useDeckNavigation.
useDeckNavigation
A React hook that implements deck navigation, computing the active slide position and helper lookups like reduced, photoOf, box, and nameOf for a presentation deck.
DeckFooter
DeckFooter is the last stop of a talk: a full screen with the halo, the logo, the tagline, the networks, the thanks and the signature, all centered.
Dumbbell
Dumbbell is a chart component that renders a dumbbell-style data visualization, formatting and signing its values and reacting to reveal and numeric formatting state.

rows.label: Form
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Form` — Form is the wrapper of a form: it places the fields and puts the submit.

rows.label: Funnel
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Funnel` — Funnel is the steps of a process and how many reach each one: centered bars that narrow with the figure (as wide as the first step at most), each with its figure, and between two steps the share that went on.

rows.label: Heartbeat
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Heartbeat` — Heartbeat is a red heart that beats with a wave around it: a machine that is alive.

rows.label: Heatmap
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Heatmap` — Heatmap is a chart organism component that renders a grid of color-coded values using a shared scale, number formatting, and reveal animation.

rows.label: LineChart
rows.summary: 3 modules. `LineChart` — LineChart is a chart organism component that renders time-series or sequential numeric data as a line chart, deriving its own x and y scales, point selection, and data keys, and using tone, number formatting, and reveal-animation utilities to render and style the plotted lines.

rows.label: LogoCarousel
rows.summary: 3 modules. `LogoCarousel` — Logo carousel module providing a React component that scrolls or cycles through a sequence of logo images as a visual element for a piece.

rows.label: Marquee
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Marquee` — Marquee is a scrolling-content display component that assembles repeated pieces into a continuous looping band and rounds related values for layout.

rows.label: ProgressBar
rows.summary: 3 modules. `ProgressBar` — ProgressBar is a time bar or an adoption bar: a track with a fill that grows from the left, labels at both ends and, optionally, milestones that light up as they are reached.

rows.label: ProgressRing
rows.summary: 3 modules. `ProgressRing` — ProgressRing is a percentage, or the way towards a goal, as a ring: a gray track and an arc that grows clockwise from twelve o'clock when it comes into view (or its Step lights up), with the figure counting up in the centre and an optional caption under it.

rows.label: Punchline
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Punchline` — Punchline is the sentence that closes a block: statement at three quarters under a hairline, with an optional transition.

rows.label: Quote
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Quote` — Quote is a sentence someone said: statement at three quarters, with the attribution under it.

rows.label: Scatter
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Scatter` — A chart organism component that renders scattered data points, deriving position, size, naming, and selection from input data while applying scale, tone, number formatting, and reveal-animation behavior.

rows.label: Schema
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Schema` — Schema is a drawing of the talk: an SVG with an accessible title and description, built from the vocabulary above.

rows.label: Share
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Share` — Share is a whole split into its parts: one bar at 100 %, its segments growing from the left when it comes into view (or its Step lights up), and a legend with each part's percentage.

rows.label: Sheet
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Sheet` — Sheet is a slide-like container component that composes a piece's visual content and relies on StepsContext at runtime, with an internal requirement that it only functions when a step-progression value is non-null.

rows.label: Slide
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Slide` — Slide is a stop of the talk: a section that fills the screen and centers its content on a 16:9 stage inside the column.

rows.label: Spotlight
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Spotlight` — Spotlight is a small UI component that conditionally renders a highlighting effect around a target element identified by an el reference.

rows.label: Statements
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Statements` — Statements are the sentences of the journey, stacked: one stop each (Deck splits the slide with data-stop), in statement, three quarters wide, with an optional ordinal in front.

rows.label: Steps
rows.summary: 4 modules. `Steps` — Steps is a React component module that renders a sequenced list of numbered or linked steps, coordinating its child Step sub-components through shared context and requiring each step with a destination to have a valid target. `StepsContext` — The current step of the surrounding Steps block (Infinity outside one: everything visible).

rows.label: Story
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Story` — Story is a story or an objection: a title, paragraphs in body-l secondary and an optional bridge in primary, all at half the grid, on a raised band.

rows.label: Timeline
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Timeline` — Timeline is a vertical axis at half the grid: a dot, a title and a body per step, joined by a continuous line.

rows.label: Tools
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Tools` — Tools is an MCP server module exposing a single exported operation as part of the set of agent-callable queries for the design system.

rows.label: Waffle
rows.summary: 3 modules. `Waffle` — Waffle is a proportion counted in squares: a grid of 10 × 10 where the highlighted part fills in reading order, one square after another, when it comes into view (or its Step lights up).
